card.name: Currulao
card.profile: An Afro-descendant marimba dance-music of Colombia's South Pacific coast (Choco, Valle del Cauca, Cauca, Narino) and Ecuador's Esmeraldas, in 6/8 with interlocking polyrhythms and call-and-response vocals (Smithsonian Folklife; Music of Colombia, Wikipedia). The ensemble centers on the marimba de chonta, cununo drums, bombo and guasa shaker; a courtship dance with handkerchief play and ritual links to arrullos and alabaos.
card.insight: Currulao is integral to UNESCO's 'Marimba music, traditional chants and dances from the Colombia South Pacific region and Esmeraldas Province of Ecuador' (file 01099): inscribed via Decision 5.COM 6.8 (Nairobi, 2010) and extended on 2 December 2015 in Windhoek to include Ecuador (UNESCO ICH).
